tools.name: import_statement
tools.description: Import a bank statement CSV (relative path in the folder). Columns are detected: date, description/memo/payee, and either amount or debit+credit. Replaces the previous statement and runs a first match.

tools.name: reconcile
tools.description: Match statement lines to ledger receipts and paid invoices by exact amount within a date window (default 3 days), then description similarity. Shows what is unexplained on either side.

tools.name: explain_line
tools.description: Manually match a statement line to a book entry (ref like receipt#12 or invoice:INV-0003) or record a note explaining it (bank fee, transfer, personal).

tools.name: review_unexplained
tools.description: Review statement lines the matcher could not explain, in DextUI forms: pick the matching receipt/invoice, explain with a note, or leave it. Answers apply per submitted batch; cancelling keeps earlier batches. Falls back to a plain list on hosts without forms.

window_days.description: date window for candidate book entries; default 14
